margin_rationale: Carry forward the fixed six-cell study's smallest aggregate SR gain treated as practically useful: 3 percentage points. Four-seed paired 90% t interval within +/-3 pp establishes equivalence for aggregate SR only; nonsignificance alone does not.
selection: Final 1000-episode checkpoint only. IL50/RL500 snapshots are diagnostic, never eligible for performance-based selection. No tuning after reading outcomes.
evidence: No explicit motion evidence in any KDA arm. The readout alone changes: coefficient 1, learned state-independent sigmoid channel scale initialized at 0.5, or existing generic gate(f,m,zero).
frozen: Same immutable ORCA data, simulator, observed contract, five actor slots, reward, 80 actions, CV successor, optimizer, IL/RL budgets and evaluator. Parameter/state counts reported; different readout capacity is intrinsic and not matched with unused parameters.
scope: Mechanism follow-up, not an automatically novel method. New training seeds and pre-fixed held-out cases within this project; no pooling with prior pilots. Online MC trajectories remain policy-dependent despite identical scene schedules.
substrate: Same compact exact KDA recurrence as the previous pilot, not optimized FLA kernels. No new backbone, predictor or memory.
